notes.title: 14th July Playtest - Join now!
notes.content:
Gear up and gather your friends as we get ready to finally dive deep into the dungeons of Bravehood! 

We are excited to announce that Bravehood Alpha 1 is officially complete and we are now manning all stations as we prepare for our first playtest on 14th July 2023! Thank you to the Bravehood community for your endless support, we could not have come this far without you.

The goal of each playtest is to give access to our community. Your contribution and feedback will be vital to the production and quality of our game. Playing with your friends is an important pillar in Bravehood, if you are one of the lucky members selected for the playtest you will be able to invite 3 friends to play along with you. Also, from here on out, you and your 3 friends will have access to all future playtests.

How to join

As this is our first playtest, we will be working at a limited invite-only basis. Players are randomly selected from our discord community to participate in the first and all future playtests, so make sure you [url=bit.ly/bravehooddc]join our discord server now [/url]

Support the community and score yourself an invite!

If you have not been selected, don’t you worry, you still have a shot at joining the playtest. The first 20 Brave members that invite the most people to the discord server will gain access to the playtests. What you need to do is right click on the server, create an invite link and send it to your friends who may be interested in joining. Please do not spam people or servers. Winners will be announced at 6th July 2023.

notes.title: Check our roadmap!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are so happy to have an embracing and patient community. We apologize for not updating here for a while due to product decisions, updates on our previous games and searching for new teammates.

As we promised, because the project achieved more than 1000 wishlists we are sharing our roadmap and playtest dates with you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43846440/54a4a9068857693699cfa5b02e5ac9e8257831a4.png[/img]

General Timeline

30 June 2023 - Alpha 1
14 July 2023 - Closed Playtest 1
21 July 2023 - Closed Playtest 2
11 August 2023 - Alpha 2
18 August 2023 - Closed Playtest 3
25 August 2023 - Closed Playtest 4
1 September 2023 -  Beta
15 September 2023 -  Open Playtest 1
29 September 2023 -  Version 1 
2 October 2023 - Demo Release
9 October 2023 - Steam NextFest October 2023
9-29 October - Demo Updates
November – Release

[b]Closed Playtest #1- 14th July 2023[/b]

Our first playtest will be on the 14th of July with 240 players capacity. 

Our first 50 members in the community will gain access to Playtest #1. Also, we will choose 10 random people from our discord community. Each chosen tester can also invite 3 friends to the playtest.

Thank you for your support and patience.

notes.title: Bravehood F.A.Q. – The PvPvE Dungeoncrawler
notes.content:
[h1]Bravehood F.A.Q. – The PvPvE Dungeoncrawler
[/h1]
Dear players,

Our community is growing each day and our team gains responsibility for each person who expected a good game from our team. We have received a lot of questions and prepared Frequently Asked Questions for our community.


[h2] Bravehood Frequently Asked Questions
[/h2]
[b]Q: What is Bravehood?
[/b]
A: Bravehood is an online PvPvE Dungeoncrawler video game.
[b]Q: How is the gameplay?
[/b]A: You create your own character and enter the dungeons with your team. You need to use potions, relics, and special weapon abilities to banish enemies in dungeons. You need to use your XP to level up and make your character stronger and create your own build.
[b]Q: How is Bravehood PvPvE gameplay?
[/b]A: It is similar to Dark Souls PvP. There are some relics that have similar functions to dark souls, like Chameleon. You can make your own strategy by using well design maps with strategic points. Each team needs to dungeon the boss and extract the soul. 
[b]Q: How is Dungeon PvP matchmaking?
[/b]A: You will choose dungeons like Minecraft Dungeons. If you enter the dungeon with PvP option enabled, you will be sent to a PvP game. You can be an invader and quickly join other people’s dungeons to invade them.
[b]Q: How is Combat gameplay?
[/b]A: It is the basic and simplified version of Soulsborne. You can roll, attack, heavy attack, and use potions and relics. Enemies have poise and you need to break them to stun them.
[b]Q: Which enemies are players going to face?
[/b]A: There are 5 regular enemy types in the game. With different gameplay, 5 mini-bosses, and 3 main bosses in the release version.

[b]Q: How many people are in the team?[/b]
A: Currently 8 people.
[i]M. Mustafa Yaya - Producer/Team Lead and Gameplay Programmer
Umut Gürdal - Development Team Lead and Gameplay Programmer
Nadir Kaan Sezi - Level & Game Designer
Efe Bektaş - Game Designer & Programmer
ibrahim Kayra Dural - Programmer
Emir Kaan Öz- Programmer
Kunter Çalışkan- Sound Designer
Aytek Kerem Küçük - Project Manager[/i]

[h2]We believe we will success with working hard and help of our community. Join us!
[/h2]
